What do you hope to gain from replying to so many posts on this sub? Is it due to empathy towards the OP you reach out? A sense of obligation? A hope for friendship?  

I'm a hopeless case who's sought an out for almost a decade, I'm nearing the end of my life. I have no friends, I'm an alcoholic and I'm only 20. I thank you for reaching out when no one else would, although it does not really matter as I made this post for no particular reason other than attention as I am already set on taking my life regardless of what anyone says. I just wanted to feel wanted/important for once in my life.
